source.origin: VERBATIM logikbench upstream CORDIC QR (qr.v + qr_array/boundary/cordic/internal.v concatenated); there are no edits, as stated in the RTLScout-marked provenance header; N/DW are module parameters set to 8/16 at TB instantiation
source.design: upstream NATIVE interface: one start pulse with the whole matrix on the 1024-bit a_in bus, result on the 1024-bit r_out bus at the done pulse; one full Givens rotation per cycle; native schedule metered per case (reset release -> done), no memory port
source.oracle: same 15 cases and goldens as qr8_1r1w (vectors.dat byte-identical, stride 128); TB checks all 64 R words per case at the done pulse
source.purpose: the upstream's own ARP under the study flow, for the upstream comparison -- a measurement vehicle, not an agent-optimization benchmark
